Title: Ensure API readiness by using the Ready! API plug-in for Azure API Management

Body.Content: Before introducing customers to your API, make sure it’s high quality and production ready. By using the API Management plugin for SmartBear Ready! API, import your API from your Azure API Management service and quickly generate a complete suite of tests based on your API definition.
